events.title: The Demo Is Now Available!
events.summary: Hello, this is STAYRESIDENT!Today, we're excited to announce that the demo for Fenestra: my focus, her future is now available!Thank you to everyone who has supported us since the announcement.Whether you're working, studying, or creating something, we hope you'll enjoy getting an early taste of spending time with Fenestra!What's Included in the DemoThe story from your first meeting with Fenestra through Episode 5 of one routePomodoro timer, To-Do list, and habit tracker4 background music playli

events.title: Fenestra: my focus, her future — Streaming Guidelines
events.summary: We welcome gameplay videos, livestreams, and other video content featuring Fenestra: my focus, her future.Individuals and organizations alike are free to stream and post videos within the scope of these guidelines.Streaming and Video ContentYou may stream or post videos of any part of the game, including all endings.You may share your content on video and streaming platforms such as YouTube, Twitch, Niconico, and bilibili.Monetization is also permitted through features provided by these platform

events.title: Fan Content Guidelines for Fenestra: my focus, her future
events.summary: Thank you for supporting Fenestra: my focus, her future.The Fenestra team welcomes fan-created works from our community.Please feel free to enjoy creating illustrations, comics, stories, videos, cosplay, fan books (doujinshi), merchandise, and other works inspired by the world and characters of Fenestra.As long as your creations fall within the scope of these guidelines, you do not need to contact us or request permission in advance.Character Reference MaterialsWe are making character reference

events.title: Hello, and thank you for 10,000 wishlists!
events.summary: Hello, everyone. We’re the development team behind Fenestra: my focus, her future. First of all, thank you so much for taking an interest in Fenestra. Since this is our first time speaking with you here, we’d like to take a moment to introduce ourselves and share a little about what’s ahead. About STAYRESIDENT STAYRESIDENT is a newly established indie game label based in Japan. We create original 3D games with worlds and characters that stay with you long after you’ve finished playing.
